US Vice President Vance Calls PM Modi to Discuss Bilateral Ties

US Vice President J.D. Vance spoke with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi by phone. The call occurred shortly after the US Senate cleared a bill imposing a 100% tariff on certain goods. Both leaders discussed strengthening cooperation and deepening the India-US strategic partnership, including trade, defense, and technology. The conversation also touched upon efforts to ensure safe passage for commercial ships through the Strait of Hormuz amid regional tensions.
